R11.method: (a) the product's stored checklist against 'Two-valued, unresolved = false' (study3.two_valued: the product's own evaluator at the frozen commit on the same admitted facts and presumptions). (b) The product's evaluator offers exact deferral only (casepath/process/workflows.py at the frozen commit has no strong Kleene mode), so strong Kleene uses harness/casepath_tenancy.py (plan_from_verified, the casepath_api engine) on the product's stored fact values (used value true/false, otherwise unresolved) and its accepted document findings, against the same harness's exact deferral (plan_from_verified_exact) on the same input, through fresh2/tenancy/build.py engine_plan. A product finding is passed only where the claim has an attachment of that document type. The row 'harness exact equals the product's workflow checklist' shows how closely the harness reproduces the product.

theft.statement: Theft: unresolved = false gives exactly CasePath's requests in 384 of 384 text-runs.

R2.method: Overall strict unsafe errors per claim = sum over the three subsets of weight x the subset's mean per claim-run. Interval: 10,000 paired cluster-bootstrap resamples of the 24 families (with replacement); in each resample the subset means of the CasePath-minus-comparator differences are pooled over the drawn families' claim-runs and reweighted; percentile 2.5-97.5. A resample with no claim of a weighted subset is drawn again (count reported).

notes: Product value = what the evaluator used: an established fact with verdict 'accepted' (admitted), a presumption, or nothing (unresolved: no reading gave a value; conflicting: readings gave different values; not accepted; absent: the case-run was routed to another workflow or failed). Truth = the designed true value (scenario, defining event, open fact's recorded value). For a designed open fact the right outcome is unresolved.

Readings: the reading responses of each case-run in the response cache (calls whose answer is a 'conditions' object), combined as team._reading does: a response that answers fewer facts than the workflow has is the requote of the reading before it. Agreement uses the raw verdicts (true / false / open / not_stated) before the quotation check.

Theft: the nine changed conditions cannot be mapped to the product's workflow facts from the harness. The reviewed workflow's facts are rule guards (g001 ...), one per distinct rule condition, and no file of the harness maps a benchmark condition (PR_...) to guards (analysis/theft_error_origin.py leaves COND_GUARD empty). A mapping would have to be made by hand from the condition texts, which is a new coding decision; it was not made.

R4.method: Each unmentioned branch fact (fact state 'absent': 139 facts, all false by design) is drawn true with probability q, independently, 200 seeded draws per q. For a drawn-true fact the reference is the engine's (fresh2/tenancy/build.py engine_plan, exact deferral, silence policy) with that fact stated true; every design's stored checklists are kept and rescored with study2.ten_row. Strict unsafe errors per claim = mean over claim-runs. Check: with no fact drawn (q = 0) the engine reproduces all 96 stored references exactly and the rescoring reproduces the stored values.

R5.h4_self_consistency_paragraph: The nine changed-fact differences (CasePath minus Self-consistency) are PR_repair_over_500 -1.750, PR_declined -1.667, PR_nachfrist_set -0.875, PR_goods_recovered -0.750, PR_bicycle_claimed -0.625, PR_scheduled_valuable_1000 -0.583, PR_sim_card_stolen -0.500, PR_expert_procedure_requested +0.125, PR_third_party_causer +1.000; mean -0.625. 7 are negative and 2 positive (PR_expert_procedure_requested, PR_third_party_causer). The percentile bootstrap resamples these nine values with replacement and asks how the mean varies if the nine were a sample from a population like themselves: because almost all of them are negative, few resamples have a mean at or above zero, so the 95% interval [-1.125, -0.079] excludes zero. The exact test asks a different question: under the null each difference is as likely to have the opposite sign, and p is the share of the 2^9 = 512 sign patterns whose absolute sum is at least the observed 5.625. 32 patterns reach it (p = 32/512 = 0.0625): the differences are unequal in size, so flipping the signs of a few small ones still leaves sums as large as the observed one, while the magnitude-blind percentile interval with nine clusters is known to be too narrow. The inverted sign-flip interval, [-1.250, +0.083], includes zero, in agreement with the exact test.

method.inverted: the set of shifts delta for which the exact two-sided sign-flip test of (differences - delta) gives p >= 0.05; grid of step 0.0005 from the smallest to the largest cluster difference, ends refined by bisection to 1e-6; contiguity checked on the grid
method.noninferiority: for H5 also the exact one-sided sign-flip p of (differences - 0.25), H0: mean difference >= 0.25
method.registered: as stored in study3_results_fresh2_confirm.json (nine changed-fact clusters; percentile cluster-bootstrap interval, 10,000 resamples)
method.stories: exact two-sided sign-flip test over the eight stories (story value = mean over its nine changed-fact pairs and three runs); 2^8 = 256 patterns, smallest p 0.0078
method.twoway: 10,000 draws; stories (8) and changed facts (9) resampled independently with replacement; statistic = mean of the cell differences (cell = story x fact, mean over three runs) over the drawn 8 x 9 grid; percentile 2.5-97.5

R6.measure: strict unsafe errors per claim, family mean over claims and runs (as H2 and H3)

R7.cost_note: Components are attributed on the case-runs whose stored agent list lines up with their distinct call keys (as study3.py does); a call is a reading when its cached answer is a 'conditions' object. The registered split books the brief to the claim reader and the confirming readings and the check to the source checker, all in 'can decide the checklist'. The checklist-only run makes the routing, the first reading, the confirming readings and, where the case has documents, the document finder and a documents-only source check; it skips the brief, the process builder and the result checker. On theft (one text, no attached document) it called neither the document finder nor the check.
